overview_description.description:
InceptionLRT was a decentralized finance (DeFi) protocol that operated as a liquid restaking platform built on EigenLayer. Founded by Pedro Verdades and Jean Simone, the project launched in August 2023.

Backed by the founders’ experience in finance and Bitcoin mining, InceptionLRT was driven by the emerging opportunity of yield stacking within the restaking ecosystem. The protocol aimed to maximize capital efficiency by enabling users to restake assets while maintaining liquidity.

InceptionLRT was formed through the merger of two specialized companies—one focused on native staking and the other on liquid staking token (LST) solutions—bringing together complementary expertise to create a unified restaking platform.

about_short_description.short_description: InceptionLRT is a standalone liquid restaking protocol designed specifically for Liquid Staking Tokens (LSTs).

product.name: Liquid Restaking Protocol
product.description: A protocol that allows users to restake their liquid staking tokens (LSTs) to provide additional security and validation services across multiple networks while maintaining liquidity.

product.name: Restaking Explorer
product.description: A real-time data platform providing transparency and insights into the restaking landscape, including validation services, node operators, curators, and DeFi integrations.

product.name: Distributed Validator Technology (DVT) Integration
product.description: A security technology that distributes validator keys across multiple independent nodes to enhance fault tolerance, decentralization, and security in restaking operations.

product.name: Liquid Restaking Tokens (LRTs)
product.description: Tokens minted on InceptionLRT representing restaked liquid staking tokens, maintaining liquidity while enabling participation in multiple DeFi strategies.

product.name: Integration with EigenLayer
product.description: A modular staking solution that leverages EigenLayer’s shared security infrastructure to enable flexible and scalable restaking of Ethereum and various liquid staking tokens.
